title: Diagnostic Value of EBUS-Guided Transbronchial Mediastinal Cryobiopsy Versus Conventional Bronchoscopic Approaches for Stage I/II Sarcoidosis
off: Diagnostic Value of EBUS-Guided Transbronchial Mediastinal Cryobiopsy Versus Conventional Bronchoscopic Approaches for Stage I/II Sarcoidosis
summary: Endobronchial ultrasound-guided transbronchial needle aspiration (EBUS-TBNA), combined with endobronchial biopsy (EBB) and/or transbronchial lung biopsy (TBLB), and endobronchial ultrasound-guided transbronchial mediastinal cryobiopsy (EBUS-TBMC) have high diagnostic yields for patients with sarcoidosis. However, a direct comparison between them has not been conducted. This randomized controlled trial aims to compare directly the diagnostic yield between EBUS-TBMC and EBUS-TBNA+EBB+TBLB in sarcoidosis.
desc: Endobronchial ultrasound-guided transbronchial needle aspiration (EBUS-TBNA), combined with endobronchial biopsy (EBB) and/or transbronchial lung biopsy (TBLB), and endobronchial ultrasound-guided transbronchial mediastinal cryobiopsy (EBUS-TBMC) have high diagnostic yields for patients with sarcoidosis. However, a direct comparison between them has not been conducted. Two questions remain need to be answered: (1) Does EBUS-TBMC have the same or better diagnostic sensitivity for sarcoidosis than EBUS-TBNA combined with standard bronchoscopic modalities (EBB or/and TBLB)? (2) Can combining EBUS-TBMC with standard bronchoscopic modalities further increase the diagnostic sensitivity for sarcoidosis? This study is designed as a randomised controlled trial to compare the diagnostic yield between EBUS-TBMC and conventional bronchoscopic approaches for diagnosing stage I/II sarcoidosis.

arms.d: Patients will receive endobronchial biopsy, transbronchial lung biopsy and EBUS-TBMC
